summary: Two adversarial tests exposed unsafe lease and archive substitution behavior.

blocking_findings.title: Lease owner write follows a swapped lease symlink
evidence: phase0-adversarial.test.ts: does not write the lease owner through a swapped lease symlink
The outside target contained owner.json after the lease path changed to a symlink.
blocking_findings.impact: A lease-path race writes owner metadata outside the retained lease directory.
blocking_findings.route: Return to Green for lease-directory revalidation before owner writes.

blocking_findings.title: Release proof accepts a substituted archive
evidence: phase0-adversarial.test.ts: rejects a valid archive substituted before clean-consumer use
A valid modified archive was installed and the release proof completed without a conflict.
blocking_findings.impact: The clean consumer can use archive bytes that the release proof did not bind before installation.
blocking_findings.route: Return to Green for archive identity binding from pack through install and digest.
